name: Competitor Watching
description: Tracks three to eight rivals across pricing pages, changelogs, feature sets, hiring and messaging, then reports weekly on what shifted. Silence is the default — nothing arrives unless a change looks material, so it suits people who want signal rather than a standing report.

official.title: Competitor Watching by Andrej
official.description: Snapshots you vs 3–8 competitors (pricing, changelog, features, jobs, messaging). Weekly diffs. Alert only on material changes.
